description: Letter codes of the regional services that register Portuguese trailers (Anexo I of the Regulamento approved by DL 54/2005: 'Tabela de dígitos identificadores dos serviços emissores de matrículas de reboques'). The original 2005 annex assigns Viseu 'VS'; the replacement annex enacted by DL 106/2006 assigns Viseu 'VI'. Both are kept, since plates issued before June 2006 legitimately carry VS.
